build_VGGBlock_cnn_module: build a VGGBlock CNN module with configurable conv layers, pooling, and optional layer normalization
create_VGGBlock_forward_pass: create a forward pass through a VGGBlock module on a BxCxTxfeat input tensor
test_infer_conv_output_dim: test infer_conv_output_dim to compute output dimensions of a conv or pooling operation
review_VGGBlock_initialization: review the VGGBlock class initialization with in_channels, out_channels, kernel sizes, and stride parameters
refactor_VGGBlock_layer_norm: refactor the VGGBlock module to enable or disable layer normalization between conv layers
